column1: What time is standard check-in?
column2: Standard check-in is at 3:00 PM.

column1: What time is standard check-out?
column2: Standard check-out is at 11:00 AM.

column1: Do you offer vegan options at breakfast?
column2: Yes
column3: the breakfast buffet includes vegan pastries

column1: Is there a shuttle to the airport?
column2: Yes
column3: our complimentary airport shuttle runs every hour from 5:00 AM to 11:00 PM.

column1: Can I request early check-in?
column2: Yes. Early check-in may be requested
column3: but it is subject to room availability.

column1: Can I store my luggage if I arrive early?
column2: Yes. Guests arriving before standard check-in may store their luggage with the front desk.

column1: Can I request late check-out?
column2: Yes. Late check-out can be requested through reception and is subject to availability.

column1: Is there a fee for late check-out?
column2: A late check-out fee may apply depending on the approved departure time.

column1: What happens if I keep my room after the approved check-out time?
column2: Guests who retain a room beyond the approved check-out time may be charged an additional night.

column1: Can I cancel a flexible booking for free?
column2: Standard flexible bookings can be cancelled free of charge up to 24 hours before the scheduled check-in date, unless a different rate-specific policy applies.

column1: What happens if I cancel within 24 hours of arrival?
column2: A cancellation made within 24 hours of arrival may be charged the equivalent of one night's stay plus applicable taxes.

column1: What is the no-show policy?
column2: In the event of a no-show, the hotel may charge one night's accommodation and applicable taxes.

column1: Do advance-purchase rates have the same cancellation policy?
column2: No. Advance-purchase, promotional, and non-refundable rates may have different cancellation conditions, which are displayed at the time of booking.

column1: When are the rooftop pool hours?
column2: The rooftop pool is open daily from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM.

column1: Are pool towels provided?
column2: Yes. Pool towels are provided at the pool deck.

column1: Do I need my room key to enter the pool area?
column2: Yes. Guests must present their room key for entry to the rooftop pool area.

column1: Can children use the rooftop pool?
column2: Yes, but children must be supervised by a parent or responsible adult at all times.

column1: Are glass containers allowed in the pool area?
column2: No. Glass containers are not permitted in the pool area.

column1: Is running allowed around the pool?
column2: No. Running and disruptive behavior are not permitted in the pool area.

column1: Can the rooftop pool close temporarily?
column2: Yes. The hotel may temporarily close the pool for maintenance, cleaning, weather, or safety reasons.

column1: Can pool access be restricted during private events?
column2: Yes. Pool access may be restricted during private events.

column1: Is Novotel pet-friendly?
column2: Yes. Novotel is a pet-friendly hotel, and pets are welcome in designated pet-friendly rooms.

column1: What is the pet fee?
column2: Pets are welcome for an additional fee of $50 per stay.

column1: How many pets are allowed per room?
column2: A maximum of two pets is permitted per room.

column1: When must I disclose that I am bringing a pet?
column2: Guests must disclose pets at the time of booking or check-in.

column1: Can I leave my pet unattended in the room?
column2: No. Pets must be supervised and must not be left unattended in guest rooms or public areas.

column1: What happens if my pet is left unattended?
column2: If a pet is found unattended, the registered guest may be charged a $100 supervision violation fee, regardless of whether the pet caused inconvenience, damage, or disturbance.

column1: Can I be charged for pet-related damage or cleaning?
column2: Yes. Additional charges may apply for damage, excessive cleaning, or other pet-policy violations.

column1: Are service animals subject to the same pet fees?
column2: Service animals are handled in accordance with applicable law and may be subject to different requirements.

column1: Is daily housekeeping provided?
column2: Daily housekeeping is generally provided during the hotel's designated housekeeping hours.

column1: Can I request reduced housekeeping?
column2: Yes. Guests may request reduced housekeeping service during their stay.

column1: Can I request no housekeeping service?
column2: Yes. Guests may request no housekeeping service during their stay.

column1: Can housekeeping enter my room?
column2: For safety and security, housekeeping staff may require access to rooms at reasonable intervals.

column1: Am I responsible for damage to hotel property?
column2: Yes. Guests are responsible for damage to hotel property beyond ordinary wear and tear.

column1: Is there a charge for a lost or damaged room key?
column2: Lost or damaged room keys may incur a replacement charge.

column1: What are the quiet hours?
column2: Quiet hours are observed from 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM.

column1: What noise level is expected during quiet hours?
column2: Guests are expected to keep noise at a level that does not disturb other guests.

column1: Are parties allowed in guest rooms?
column2: No. Parties, amplified music, and other activities that create excessive noise are not permitted in guest rooms or corridors.

column1: What can happen after repeated noise violations?
column2: Repeated violations may result in removal from the property without refund, subject to applicable law and hotel procedures.

column1: Are guest rooms non-smoking?
column2: Yes. All guest rooms are non-smoking areas.

column1: Are indoor public areas non-smoking?
column2: Yes. All indoor public areas are non-smoking and non-vaping areas.

column1: Where is smoking or vaping permitted?
column2: Smoking and vaping are permitted only in designated outdoor areas.

column1: What is the smoking or vaping cleaning fee?
column2: A cleaning and restoration fee of $250 may be charged when smoking or vaping occurs in a non-smoking room.

column1: Can local laws impose additional smoking restrictions?
column2: Yes. Local laws and property-specific restrictions may impose additional requirements.

column1: Is on-site parking available?
column2: On-site parking may be available for registered guests, subject to capacity and applicable fees.

column1: Does parking guarantee a reserved space?
column2: No. Parking does not guarantee a reserved space unless the space is explicitly confirmed.

column1: Where should I park my vehicle?
column2: Vehicles should be parked only in designated areas.

column1: Is the hotel responsible for theft or damage to vehicles?
column2: The hotel is not responsible for theft, loss, or damage to vehicles or their contents except where required by applicable law.

column1: Is Wi-Fi complimentary?
column2: Yes. Complimentary Wi-Fi is available to registered guests in guest rooms and common areas.

column1: Is uninterrupted Wi-Fi guaranteed?
column2: No. Network performance may vary depending on usage, location, and service availability. The hotel does not guarantee uninterrupted internet access.

column1: Is the hotel responsible for data loss caused by an internet interruption?
column2: No. The hotel is not responsible for loss of data resulting from network interruptions.

column1: What should guests do during an emergency?
column2: Guests should follow instructions from hotel staff and emergency services.

column1: Can fire exits and emergency doors be blocked?
column2: No. Fire exits, emergency doors, and safety equipment must remain unobstructed.

column1: Are candles and open flames allowed in rooms?
column2: No. Candles and open flames are not permitted in guest rooms.

column1: Can I use an unauthorized cooking appliance in my room?
column2: No. Unauthorized cooking appliances are not permitted in guest rooms.

column1: What should I do if I notice suspicious activity?
column2: Report suspicious activity to the front desk immediately.

column1: Are visitors allowed at the hotel?
column2: Registered guests are responsible for visitors they invite onto the property. Visitors may be permitted but may be subject to registration and identification requirements.

column1: Do visitors need to register?
column2: Visitors may be required to register with the front desk and provide identification.

column1: Can visitors stay beyond the room's occupancy limit?
column2: No. Maximum room occupancy limits must be observed.

column1: Can the hotel restrict a visitor's access?
column2: Yes. The hotel reserves the right to restrict access to individuals whose behavior creates a safety, security, or disturbance concern.

column1: Are accessible rooms available?
column2: Accessible rooms and facilities may be available upon request and subject to availability.

column1: When should I communicate accessibility requirements?
column2: Guests who require accessibility features are encouraged to communicate their requirements before arrival.

column1: Can the hotel provide accessibility assistance?
column2: The hotel will provide appropriate assistance where possible, based on the guest's requirements and available facilities.

column1: Is a payment method required at check-in?
column2: Yes. A valid payment method may be required at check-in to cover accommodation charges, taxes, and incidental expenses.

column1: Will the hotel place a deposit or authorization on my card?
column2: A temporary authorization or deposit may be placed on the payment card.

column1: How long does it take to release a card authorization?
column2: The release of an authorization is subject to the card issuer's processing times.

column1: What incidental charges may be added to my bill?
column2: Additional charges may include food and beverage purchases, damage, excessive cleaning, late check-out, pet-related fees, or other services used during the stay.

column1: What should I do if I lose an item at the hotel?
column2: Contact the front desk as soon as possible to report a missing item.

column1: How are found items handled?
column2: Items found on hotel premises are handled according to the property's lost-and-found procedures.

column1: How long are unclaimed items kept?
column2: The hotel may retain unclaimed items only for a limited period before disposal or donation, subject to local requirements.

column1: What behavior is expected from guests?
column2: Guests are expected to behave respectfully toward other guests and hotel employees.

column1: Are threats or violence permitted?
column2: No. Harassment, threats, violence, illegal activity, intentional property damage, and serious disturbances are prohibited.

column1: What action may the hotel take for serious misconduct?
column2: The hotel may take appropriate action, including contacting security or authorities and terminating a stay, where permitted by law.

column1: Can a stay be terminated for serious disturbances?
column2: Yes. The hotel may terminate a stay for serious disturbances or prohibited conduct, where permitted by law and hotel procedures.

column1: Who is responsible for visitors I invite?
column2: Registered guests are responsible for visitors they invite onto the property.

column1: Can the hotel charge for excessive room cleaning?
column2: Yes. Additional charges may apply for excessive cleaning, including cleaning required because of smoking, vaping, pets, or other violations.

column1: Can I use candles for a celebration in my room?
column2: No. Candles and open flames are not permitted in guest rooms. Please contact the hotel about approved celebration arrangements.

column1: Can I bring a portable cooking appliance?
column2: Unauthorized cooking appliances are not permitted in guest rooms.

column1: Can I smoke or vape on my room balcony?
column2: Smoking and vaping are permitted only in designated outdoor areas. Please confirm whether a particular outdoor area is designated before smoking or vaping.

column1: Can I leave my pet alone while I use the pool?
column2: No. Pets must not be left unattended in guest rooms or public areas.

column1: Does the pet fee include damage or excessive cleaning?
column2: No. The $50 pet fee is an additional fee per stay; separate charges may apply for damage, excessive cleaning, or other violations.

column1: Does complimentary Wi-Fi apply to visitors?
column2: Complimentary Wi-Fi is available to registered guests. Visitor access is subject to hotel procedures.

column1: What happens if I obstruct a fire exit?
column2: Fire exits, emergency doors, and safety equipment must remain unobstructed. Guests must comply with posted safety procedures and hotel instructions.

column1: Can pool access change because of weather?
column2: Yes. The hotel may temporarily close the rooftop pool for weather or safety reasons.

column1: Can I request housekeeping outside designated hours?
column2: Requests outside designated housekeeping hours are subject to staff availability and hotel procedures.

column1: What if I need accessibility assistance after arrival?
column2: Contact the front desk and explain your requirements. The hotel will provide appropriate assistance where possible.

column1: Can I bring a visitor into the pool area?
column2: Pool entry requires a room key, and visitor access is subject to hotel procedures, capacity, and safety requirements.

column1: What happens if my vehicle is parked outside a designated area?
column2: Vehicles should be parked only in designated areas. The hotel may take action in accordance with its parking procedures and applicable law.

column1: Can I request a refund after being removed for a policy violation?
column2: Removal without refund may apply for repeated noise violations or serious misconduct, subject to applicable law and hotel procedures.

column1: Where can I find emergency instructions?
column2: Guests should follow the posted emergency instructions and directions from hotel staff and emergency services.

column1: What are the spa timings?
column2: The spa is open 24/7 but requires booking at least 2 hours prior to time of arrival.

column1: What are the charges applicable for the spa?
column2: Charges are applicable based on type of massage or service the customer demands. The customer can view the price list near the spa at the roof top or refer the pamphlet given in their room upon check-in.

column1: Does the hotel retain my personal details and my pet's name forever after I check out, or what is the privacy policy?
column2: Yes, the hotel does retain some of the personal details provided along with your preferences to make your experience better the next time you arrive. We assure you that the hotel prioritizes guest privacy and confidentiality regarding personal and stay records in accordance with its data retention and guest privacy guidelines.

column1: What should I do if other guests are making excessive noise during quiet hours?
column2: According to our hotel policy, Quiet hours are observed from 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM. Guests are expected to keep noise at a level that does not disturb other guests. We will look into the matter immediately. Kindly provide any other information about the people making noise like their room number or the location from which this noise is coming.

column1: How does the hotel handle severe food allergies or dietary restrictions for room service?
column2: Guests with severe food allergies or dietary restrictions should notify the hotel or front desk when ordering so the kitchen can take strict precautions against cross-contamination.
